question.text: A projectile is fired with a velocity u making an angle $\theta$ with the horizontal. What is the magnitude of change in velocity when it is at the highest point -

solution.text:
Initially $\mathrm{u}=\cos \theta \hat{\mathrm{i}}+\mathrm{u} \sin \theta \hat{\mathrm{j}}$.

At highest point $\mathrm{v}=\mathrm{u} \cos \theta \hat{\mathrm{i}}$

$\therefore$ difference is $\mathrm{u} \sin \theta$
